propositions: Git 2.38+ floor is not currently declared or enforced; the merge-tree regression test added for bug 8185 uses git merge-tree --write-tree which requires Git 2.38+ but the repository allows the test to run (or skip silently) on older clients.

The operator decision mandates ENFORCING the Git 2.38+ floor via session-wide failure rather than a skip guard, to prevent vacuous test execution where the regression goes uncollected on under-floor contributors.

The floor is now single-sourced in .github/git-version-floor.txt and enforced at pytest session initialization via tests/conftest.py::pytest_configure, which raises pytest.UsageError with diagnostic naming the required version, installed version, and upgrade path.

CI gates enforce the floor in both the push/PR lane and Gerrit Verified lane via a version-check step before the pytest job, and the 8185 regression test executes on every gating environment without skip paths.

Non-vacuity guards (test_the_merge_tree_regressions_are_still_present and test_no_merge_tree_regression_is_guarded_by_skip_machinery) fail loudly if the capability probe or skip machinery is missing or misplaced, preventing silent regression by module split or rename.
